_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: the deliverable is the words themselves. Should-not-trigger: a brief whose deliverable is a finished video (the video workflow calls this as a step), or a request to record audio, which is generating-audio.
